item.title: US health authorities contradict state officials on measles-related deaths
item.description: Clash with Pennsylvania comes as US records highest number of measles cases in decades.

item.title: 'I've never been to Afghanistan': Six million deportees forced to start over under the Taliban
item.description: As of August, the number forced to return this year from Pakistan and Iran had reached another million.

item.title: Israel says senior Hamas member seized as strikes kill three during Gaza raid
